newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Bosnia plant to test Venezuela's orimulsion.
newsitem.headline: Bosnia plant to test Venezuela's orimulsion.

text.p: Bosnia's Mostar aluminium plant has signed a memorandum of understanding with Venezuela's state oil subsidiary Bitor to test Venezuela's bitumen-based boiler fuel orimulsion, Bitor said in a statement on Wednesday.
Mijo Brajkovic, president of Mostar Aluminium Complex in Bosnia-Herzegovina, said the plant had been halted due to the Yugoslav civil war, but he expected to start running again on July 15.
He hoped to receive the first orimulsion imports between August and September, the statement said.
The statement did not specify the size of the test volumes or how much the plant might burn in the long term.
Orimulsion is a blend of bitumen and water which Venezuela is selling to electricity generators worldwide as a cheap replacement for coal.
